title: Argument-first evaluation convention for derived Hom
statement: Let $C$ be a preadditive category, $T:C\times C\to C$ a tensor bifunctor, $J$ a predicate on $C^{\mathrm{op}}\times C$, and $H:J\to C$ a permitted internal-Hom functor. Let $S$ be partial closed data with Hom-first evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_{M,N}:T(H(M,N),M)\to N$ [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces]. For a specified family of symmetry isomorphisms $\beta_{U,V}:T(U,V)\xrightarrow{\sim}T(V,U)$, define argument-first evaluation at each permitted pair $(M,N)$ to be $\beta_{M,H(M,N)}$ followed by $\operatorname{ev}_{M,N}$, a map $T(M,H(M,N))\to N$. No naturality or symmetry identities beyond the supplied isomorphisms are required for this definition.
